framing: ASEAN pedagogy — Hà Nội-Ho Chi Minh City dialectic
description: Trò chơi giáo dục tiếng Việt — The Vietnamese locale emphasizes the dialectic between Hà Nội (north, tradition, scholarship) and Hồ Chí Minh City (south, commerce, modernity). Pedagogy centers on duality: yin-yang of trade routes, complementary agents, the witness as both observer and participant.
pedagogical_lens: The Vietnamese dialectic (âm-dương): trade routes require balance. The witness-log records complementary perspectives. North-South-East-West become the cardinal dimensions of commerce.
